"$self": https://www.ukiryu.com/register/1.0/ghostscript/10.0
name: ghostscript
display_name: Ghostscript PS/PDF Interpreter
homepage: https://www.ghostscript.com/
version: '10.0'
aliases:
- gs
- gswin64c
- gswin32c
profiles:
- name: unix
  display_name: Ghostscript on Unix
  platforms:
  - macos
  - linux
  shells:
  - bash
  - zsh
  option_style: single_dash_equals
  commands:
  - name: convert
    description: Convert PostScript or PDF to other formats
    usage: gs [options] input-file
    options:
    - name: device
      cli: "-sDEVICE"
      type: string
      assignment_delimiter: equals
      description: Output device (e.g., png16m, jpeg, pdfwrite)
    - name: output
      cli: "-sOutputFile"
      type: file
      assignment_delimiter: equals
      description: Output file path
    - name: resolution
      cli: "-r"
      type: string
      assignment_delimiter: auto
      description: Resolution (e.g., 150, 300, or 600x600)
    flags:
    - name: quiet
      cli: "-q"
      default: false
      description: Quiet mode
    - name: batch
      cli: "-dBATCH"
      default: true
      description: Batch mode
    arguments:
    - name: inputs
      type: file
      required: false
      position: last
      variadic: true
      min: 1
      separator: " "
      description: Input file(s) to process
    standalone_executable: false
- name: windows
  display_name: Ghostscript on Windows
  platforms:
  - windows
  shells:
  - powershell
  - cmd
  option_style: single_dash_equals

    options:
    - name: device
      cli: "-sDEVICE"
      type: string
      assignment_delimiter: equals
      description: Output device (e.g., png16m, jpeg, pdfwrite)
    - name: output
      cli: "-sOutputFile"
      type: file
      assignment_delimiter: equals
      description: Output file path
    - name: resolution
      cli: "-r"
      type: string
      assignment_delimiter: auto
      description: Resolution (e.g., 150, 300, or 600x600)
    flags:
    - name: quiet
      cli: "-q"
      default: false
      description: Quiet mode
    - name: batch
      cli: "-dBATCH"
      default: true
      description: Batch mode
    arguments:
    - name: inputs
      type: file
      required: false
      position: last
      variadic: true
      min: 1
      separator: " "
      description: Input file(s) to process
    standalone_executable: false

ok.yaml:
---
ukiryu_schema: '1.0'
"$self": https://www.ukiryu.com/register/1.0/inkscape/1.0
name: inkscape
display_name: Inkscape Vector Graphics Editor
homepage: https://inkscape.org/
version: '1.0'
aliases:
- ink
profiles:
- name: modern_unix
  display_name: Modern Inkscape on Unix
  platforms:
  - macos
  - linux
  shells:
  - bash
  - zsh
  option_style: double_dash_equals
  commands:
  - name: export
    description: Export document to different format
    usage: inkscape [OPTIONS] input.svg
    options:
    - name: output
      cli: "--export-filename"
      type: file
      assignment_delimiter: equals
      description: Output filename
    - name: format
      cli: "--export-type"
      type: symbol
      assignment_delimiter: equals
      values:
      - svg
      - png
      - pdf
      description: Output format
    flags:
    - name: plain
      cli: "--export-plain-svg"
      default: false
      description: Remove Inkscape-specific attributes
    arguments:
    - name: inputs
      type: file
      required: false
      position: last
      variadic: true
      min: 1
      separator: " "
      description: Input file(s)
    use_env_vars:
    - headless
    standalone_executable: false
  env_var_sets:
    headless:
    - name: DISPLAY
      value: ''
      platforms:
      - macos
      - linux
      description: Disable display for headless operation
version_detection:
  command:
  - "--version"
  pattern: Inkscape (\d+\.\d+)
  modern_threshold: '1.0'
  source: command
